claims.actualSource: have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := Nat.le_trans (by norm_num) hn
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: 3≤4≤n supplies the existing provider's exact n≥3 hypothesis.

claims.actualSource:
have hwindow0 :
      (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / (2 * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
    div_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (n : ℝ))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (1 / 2 : ℝ))))
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: sqrt(n)≥0 and 2*exp(1/2)>0 prove the provider's tilt-zero upper-window condition; no asymptotic assumption is used.

claims.actualSource:
have hmodel :=
    Shao.OQ6.ActualQuadraticTiltMoments.actual_quadratic_source_moments
      μ h hh hh2 hhsymm hcenter hprojectionsecond n hn3 0 (le_refl 0) hwindow0
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Instantiates the qualified actual source theorem at the same μ,h,n and x=0 with precisely the original hh/hh2/symmetry/mean/projection normalization assumptions.

claims.actualSource: have hg : Measurable g := hmodel.1
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: First output of that exact instantiated TYPE is global measurability of literal g.

claims.actualSource:
have hr : Measurable (fun t : Ω × Ω => r t.1 t.2) :=
    hmodel.2.2.2.2.1
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: After four right projections, the next left output is joint measurability of literal r; it is not an a.e. measurability substitute.

claims.actualSource:
have habs (f : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) :
      Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => |f ξ|) := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hf.norm
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The local universal helper composes measurable real norm with f and rewrites norm=abs. f is data, hf is a proof, and no extra theorem premise is introduced.

claims.actualSource:
have hgcoord (i : Fin n) :
      Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => g (ξ i)) :=
    hg.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Each full Pi coordinate is measurable, hence composition with g is measurable.

claims.actualSource:
have hrcoord (i j : Fin n) :
      Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => r (ξ i) (ξ j)) :=
    hr.comp ((measurable_pi_apply i).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply j))
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Pair of coordinate evaluations is measurable; composing joint r preserves measurability even when i=j or observations coincide.

claims.actualSource:
have hW : Measurable W := by
    change Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      (∑ i : Fin n, g (ξ i)) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))
    exact (Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
      (fun (i : Fin n) (_hi : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hgcoord i)).div_const _
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Finite sum of g-coordinate functions divided by the fixed original sqrt(n); the change is the literal projectionW definition.

claims.actualSource:
have hgsquares :
      Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => ∑ i : Fin n, g (ξ i) ^ 2) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
    intro i _hi
    simpa only [pow_two] using (hgcoord i).mul (hgcoord i)
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Each square is the product of the same measurable coordinate function; finite summation is valid.

claims.actualSource:
have hV : Measurable V := by
    change Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      Real.sqrt ((∑ i : Fin n, g (ξ i) ^ 2) / (n : ℝ)))
    exact (hgsquares.div_const (n : ℝ)).sqrt
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Fixed division by n followed by total real sqrt gives precisely projectionV.

claims.actualSource:
have hupper : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      Shao.OQ6.CanonicalDoubleGhostScalarMoments.originalUpper n r ξ) := by
    unfold Shao.OQ6.CanonicalDoubleGhostScalarMoments.originalUpper
    apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
    intro i _hi
    apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
    intro j _hj
    by_cases hij : i < j
    · simpa only [if_pos hij] using hrcoord i j
    · simpa only [if_neg hij] using
        (measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ξ : Fin n → Ω => (0 : ℝ)))
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The i<j branch depends on fixed finite indices, not on the sample; each summand is r-coordinate or zero, followed by two finite sums.

claims.actualSource:
have hD : Measurable D := by
    change Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      Shao.OQ6.CanonicalDoubleGhostScalarMoments.originalUpper n r ξ /
        (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1)))
    exact hupper.div_const _
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The exact V=0 piecewise definition uses hVzero; its other branch is s2/V²-1. Total division needs no nonzero premise.

claims.actualSource:
have hrrow (i : Fin n) : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
        (fun j k : Fin n => r (ξ j) (ξ k)) i) := by
    unfold Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
    exact Finset.measurable_sum (Finset.univ.erase i)
      (fun (j : Fin n) (_hj : j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i) => hrcoord i j)
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Finite sum over univ.erase i excludes the diagonal and uses hrcoord on each actual row entry.

claims.actualSource:
have hrowsquares : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      ∑ i : Fin n, (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
        (fun j k : Fin n => r (ξ j) (ξ k)) i) ^ 2) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
    intro i _hi
    simpa only [pow_two] using (hrrow i).mul (hrrow i)
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Squared original row sums are measurable and summed over the original Fin n.

claims.actualSource:
have hJ : Measurable J := by
    simpa only [J, residualEnergyJ_eq_rowSqSum] using
      hrowsquares.div_const (((n : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2)
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Uses the qualified unconditional original row-square identity; its denominator is exactly (n-2)^2.

claims.actualSource: have hA : Measurable A := habs D hD
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Applies habs to the signed full D.

claims.actualSource:
have hB1 : Measurable B1 := by
    change Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      C0 * (((1 + rho) * 1) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) +
        J ξ / ((1 + rho) * 1 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))))
    exact measurable_const.mul
      (measurable_const.add (hJ.div_const _))
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The literal fixed y=1 budget is a real constant plus J divided by a constant, multiplied by C0.

claims.actualSource:
have hsample (i j : Fin n) : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>

    exact ((hgcoord i).add (hgcoord j)).add (hrcoord i j)
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The actual sampled h=g_i+g_j+r_ij is measurable by the two additions.

claims.actualSource:
have hrowmean (i : Fin n) : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.rowMean (sampledKernel n g r ξ) i) := by
    unfold Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.rowMean
    exact measurable_const.mul
      (Finset.measurable_sum (Finset.univ.erase i)
        (fun (j : Fin n) (_hj : j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i) => hsample i j))
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The literal rowMean is its fixed original inverse coefficient times a finite erased-diagonal sum.

claims.actualSource:
have hustat : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.uStatistic (sampledKernel n g r ξ)) := by
    unfold Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.uStatistic Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum
    apply Measurable.mul measurable_const
    apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
    intro i _hi
    apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
    intro j _hj
    by_cases hij : i < j
    · simpa only [if_pos hij] using hsample i j
    · simpa only [if_neg hij] using
        (measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ξ : Fin n → Ω => (0 : ℝ)))
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The actual choose(n,2) inverse coefficient multiplies the unordered i<j sum of sampledKernel. The branch treatment is sample-independent.

claims.actualSource:
have hcenteredrowsquares : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      ∑ i : Fin n,
        (Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.rowMean (sampledKernel n g r ξ) i -
          Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.uStatistic (sampledKernel n g r ξ)) ^ 2) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
    intro i _hi
    simpa only [pow_two] using
      ((hrowmean i).sub hustat).mul ((hrowmean i).sub hustat)
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Subtracts the same actual uStatistic from every actual rowMean, squares and sums; no row-centering term is discarded.

claims.actualSource:
have hs2 : Measurable s2 := by
    change Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      ((4 * ((n : ℝ) - 1) / ((n : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2) *
        ∑ i : Fin n,
          (Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.rowMean (sampledKernel n g r ξ) i -
            Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.uStatistic (sampledKernel n g r ξ)) ^ 2) / 4)
    exact (measurable_const.mul hcenteredrowsquares).div_const 4
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The displayed expression is exactly FiniteRows.jackknifeSq(sampledKernel)/4, with its original 4(n-1)/(n-2)^2 coefficient.

claims.actualSource: have hs : Measurable s := hs2.sqrt
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Total sqrt of hs2 gives the frozen physical s.

claims.actualSource:
have hVzero : MeasurableSet {ξ : Fin n → Ω | V ξ = 0} :=

claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The equality preimage V=0 is measurable in the full Pi domain, using real MeasurableEq.

have he : Measurable e := by

have hTclip : Measurable Tclip := by
    change Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω =>
      if V ξ = 0 then 0 else
        (W ξ + D ξ) / (V ξ * Real.sqrt (1 + e ξ)))
    exact Measurable.ite hVzero measurable_const

claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The V=0 guard is retained; the other branch uses (W+D)/(V*sqrt(1+e)) with the correct full e.

claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Uses hszero, not hVzero; the other branch is (W+D)/s exactly.

claims.actualSource:
have hpositive (ξ : Fin n → Ω) : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + e ξ := by

      hC0 (Real.sqrt_nonneg v) (by norm_num)).1

claims.actualSource:

claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: The qualified zero contract gives exactly d=e=Tclip=0 on V=0 and makes no physical-T assertion.

claims.actualSource:
have hcap : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => cap ξ i) := by
    exact ((habs (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => g (ξ i)) (hgcoord i)).div_const N).min
      measurable_const
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Real abs of the i-th g-coordinate, fixed sqrt(n) division and min with the fixed compact threshold prove full-sample measurability.

claims.actualSource:

claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data

claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data

claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data

have hDdeleq (ξ : Fin n → Ω) : Ddel ξ i = Dret (pdel ξ) := by
    change Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum
        (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.eraseIncident
          (fun j k : Fin n => r (ξ j) (ξ k)) i) /
        (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1)) =
      F (fun j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i} => ξ j.val) /
        (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    rw [hFeq ξ]
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Definitional unfolding exposes precisely the existing erased unordered pair-sum equality; rewriting changes its numerator only.

claims.actualSource:
have hJdeleq (ξ : Fin n → Ω) : Jdel ξ i = Jret (pdel ξ) := by
    change (∑ j : Fin n,
        (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
          (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.eraseIncident
            (fun k l : Fin n => r (ξ k) (ξ l)) i) j) ^ 2) /
        ((n : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2 =
      Lrow (fun j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i} => ξ j.val) / ((n : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2
    rw [hLroweq ξ]
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Definitional unfolding exposes the existing erased original row-square sum equality, preserving its denominator.

claims.actualSource:
have hB1deleq (ξ : Fin n → Ω) : B1del ξ i = Bret (pdel ξ) := by
    change C0 * (((1 + rho) * 1) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) +
        Jdel ξ i / ((1 + rho) * 1 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) =
      C0 * (((1 + rho) * 1) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) +
        Jret (pdel ξ) / ((1 + rho) * 1 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)))
    rw [hJdeleq ξ]
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Rewrites only Jdel to Jret(pdel ξ) in the exact same budget.

claims.actualSource:
have hDdel : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Ddel ξ i) := by
    rw [show (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Ddel ξ i) =
        (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Dret (pdel ξ)) from
      funext (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => hDdeleq ξ)]
    exact hDret.comp hpdel
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Pointwise identity is promoted by funext, and composition Dret∘pdel is measurable.

claims.actualSource:
have hJdel : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Jdel ξ i) := by
    rw [show (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Jdel ξ i) =
        (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Jret (pdel ξ)) from
      funext (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => hJdeleq ξ)]
    exact hJret.comp hpdel
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Identical valid transfer for Jdel using its actual equality.

claims.actualSource:
have hAdel : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Adel ξ i) :=
    habs (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Ddel ξ i) hDdel
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Applies habs to signed Ddel, preserving the frozen Adel.

claims.actualSource:
have hB1del : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => B1del ξ i) := by
    rw [show (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => B1del ξ i) =
        (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Bret (pdel ξ)) from
      funext (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => hB1deleq ξ)]
    exact hBret.comp hpdel
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Valid funext/composition transfer of the literal B1del equality.

claims.actualSource:
have hdeletedTest : Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => deletedTest ξ i) := by
    exact hcap.mul
      ((habs (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => A ξ - Adel ξ i) (hA.sub hAdel)).add
        (measurable_const.mul
          (habs (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => B1 ξ - B1del ξ i) (hB1.sub hB1del))))
claims.classification: derived Prop proof; any quantified function/index parameter separately data
claims.independentJustification: Takes the actual differences A-Adel and B1-B1del, their abs, fixed z multiplication, sum and multiplication by full cap.
